data.name: Fateha
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Fateha is derived from the root word 'fatha' which means 'to open'. It is also a term used in Islamic tradition for the first chapter of the Quran, which is called 'Al-Fatiha'. The name symbolizes the opening of the heart to receive the blessings of Allah.
